name: dnd-ai-the-dungeon-master
description: AI-powered D&D Dungeon Master with multi-language support

scripts.build: npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "vite" "node dist/src/server.js"
scripts.stop: powershell -Command "netstat -ano | findstr :3000 | findstr LISTENING | for %%a in (%%a) { taskkill /F /PID %%a }"
